notes.title: v1.1.2.2 - Bossfight bug fixes!
notes.notes: Bossfight should be a lot more playable now!

notes.title: v1.1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Airborne v1.1.0!
- Fixed level packs playing out of order bug
- Fixed canvas overlaying bugs
- Fixed soft-lock bugs
- FIxed UI inconsistencies
- Fixed death bug
- Fixed bullets going through lasers
- Fixed create level bug
- Fixed copy level bugs
- Fixed pause menu bugs

notes.title: v1.0.4 - Major Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This is a bugfix exclusive update, as well as the last minor update before v1.1.0!

- Almost all boss fight bugs fixed.
- Online level loading completely fixed
- Turret indicators improved
- Removed rich text
- Small physics changes

& a lot more bug fixes!

To submit bugs, issues or feedback join the Airborne Discord!
https://discord.gg/bChnP93xKX

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Physics Update & more!
notes.notes:
1.0.3 mainly includes a physics update, level reworks, bug fixes as well as some QoL features.

- The player's jump doesn't get interrupted by rotating!
- Added coyote time for the player.
- Turrets now have an indicator when they are about to shoot.
- In the editor, when hovering over level borders they get transparent so you can see if any objects are behind them.
- Vertical Sync can now be changed in the settings menu
- Buffed level 47.
- Nerfed / reworked numerous levels, such as 50, 48, 18 & more.

- Online level loading shouldn't fail anymore.
- Object count limit in editor pause menu is now accurate.
- Turrets being inconsistent should now be fixed.
- Workshop agreement link now in the "Workshop Agreement Needed" UI
- Music & SFX slider now mutes the music when set to 0.
- Small speedrun mode fixes

& more!

Join the Airborne Discord :) https://discord.gg/CKqjcRQG7S

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.1 is out now!

Thanks for the support on Airborne's release!
This update includes a bunch of early patches and bug fixes.

Patch Notes:
- Level limits increased, including name length which is now 32. (Prevents levels from crashing)
- Upload form in the level editor now has a character limit.
- Buttons now have indicators for when they restart if you die.
- The level search view is now bigger so you can view more levels. 
- You can't fall through the map on the boss fight.
- Bunch of levels nerfed, specifically 10, 18, 32, 38, 40, 43, 48.
- More consistent UI in the Main Menu
- Refresh button on the level search menu
- Online levels menu is now bigger so more levels can be viewed.
- Levels not loading bug is fixed
- Small credits update
- Spike hitboxes nerfed
& more!

Thanks for playing Airborne!
If you want to submit bugs or join the community, join the Discord!
https://discord.gg/qWtH447ug2
